Parmesan Steaks
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 19, 2009 - 11:45pm

Ingredients




6 cube steaks (1 ½ lbs.)
1/4 cup grated Parmesan
1 cup mashed potato flakes
3 eggs
1 clove garlic, minced
1 1/2 teaspoons salt
1/2 teaspoon pepper
 cup oil
1 cup tomato sauce with cheese
1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese

Preparation

1 Combine 1/4 cup cheese with potato flakes. Beat eggs with garlic, salt and pepper. Dip steak in egg mixture, then into potato flakes. Brown in oil. Place in baking dish. Bake at 325 degrees for 15 minutes. Add tomato sauce and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup of cheese. Continue baking for 30 to 40 minutes.
